source: StatHead fit to completed two-team trades in public Sleeper dynasty and keeper leagues
unit: 100 = a mid 1st in the next rookie draft, the same week; additive (two 50s trade for one 100)

fields.change1w / change4w / change12w: change in the as-of value over 1, 4, 12 weeks (0.10 = +10%)
fields.velocity: weekly rate of change: least-squares slope of log value over the last 4 weeks (0.05 = +5%/week)
fields.acceleration: velocity now minus velocity over the 4 weeks before
fields.volatility: standard deviation of weekly changes over the last 12 weeks (0.05 = 5%/week)
fields.trend: rising / falling / flat: the 4-week change beyond twice what 4 weeks of ordinary weekly noise (volatility) would give
fields.dispersion: how much the last 4 weeks of trades disagree: robust spread of the value each trade implies for the player (the other side's total minus his own side's other assets), as a %
fields.ciLow / ciHigh: 90% range for the current value: trade dispersion over the 4-week count, plus the value's own weekly volatility
fields.high52w / low52w / fromHigh: 52-week as-of range, and the current value against the high
fields.rank / posRank: rank on StatHead value, offense only (QB/RB/WR/TE), overall and in position
fields.trades1w / trades4w / trades8w / tradesA: trades the player was in: liquidity
fields.scoring: TEs and QBs: the same value in other scorings (value x the format's scoring factor): tePremiumUnder0.75 / tePremium0.75Plus (bonus points per TE catch), passTd6 (6-point passing TDs). value itself is for no TE premium and 4-point passing TDs.

note: value: as of the newest week. valueNwAgo: the value as it stood N weeks ago, from trades up to then only (the history file is as-of too). lastTraded: the week of the player's last trade. trades8w / tradesAll: trades the player was in. idp: a defensive player, valued from IDP leagues only. Every player is fitted; players in fewer than 20 trades are not published.

nextWeek.note: median |log(side A / side B)| of each week's trades priced with the previous week's as-of values (out of sample), and by the smoothed fit, which had seen them

holdout.note: median |log(side A / side B)| on held-out leagues: per lambda, a static fit (one value per player for all time) and counting every asset as 1

outliers.note: each trade priced with the previous week's as-of values (out of sample, scoring factors on); outlier = one side worth 2.5x+ the other, extreme = 4x+. screens are known when the trade was made: orphanSide (a side with no manager), repeatPair6 (the same two managers' 6th+ trade that league-season), afterDeadline, mega10Assets (10+ players and picks). downWeighted: outliers screened orphanSide or repeatPair6, fitted at weight 0.1. weeklyOutlierShare: the last 52 weeks, oldest first (None under 50 trades).

sensitivity.note: newest published values refitted over the last weeks with these trades weighted 0, against the published values: median / 90th percentile change over published players, and over the top 100
